scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance for Technology Acquisition
other_conditions: The enterprise must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise (MSME).
It must be run by a SC or ST entrepreneur with at least 51% contribution from the SC/ST owner.
Both new and existing enterprises engaged in manufacturing or process improvement are eligible.
Technology must be acquired from a recognized institution and be relevant to the enterprise’s product or process.
The MoU/Agreement/Contract for technology acquisition must be signed within one year.
Prior approval must be obtained from the MSME Commissionerate.
benefits_summary: Covers up to 70% of technology acquisition costs, up to ₹5,000,000.
